_comment: The l402_producer ownership-verification contract BOTH ports must match: action verify with proxy_id, and action verification_token. Read by python/lightning-enable-mcp/tests/test_producer_verify.py and dotnet/tests/LightningEnable.Mcp.Tests/Tools/ProducerVerifyTests.cs. The server routes are GET /api/proxy/{proxyId}/verification, POST .../verification/token and POST /api/proxy/{proxyId}/verify (ProxyVerificationController). Argument names are the Python snake_case. Change this file and both ports together.

methods.proves: that you control the web root of the target host
methods.chooseWhen: you control the web server for the target's hostname and can add a file at its root

methods.proves: that you control the DNS zone for the target's hostname
methods.chooseWhen: someone else hosts the API but you manage DNS for its hostname

methods.proves: only that you control the API's responses at the target base URL
methods.chooseWhen: you own the API's code but not the web root or DNS

reasonHints.contains: The target host was refused before any request
reasonHints.hint: No method ran: the target host resolves to a private or internal address, or does not resolve. Point the proxy at the API's public HTTPS address.

reasonHints.contains: The target URL cannot be verified
reasonHints.hint: No method ran: the target base URL uses an IP address, localhost or an internal domain, a port other than 80 or 443, or a scheme other than http or https. Update the proxy's target to the API's public hostname, then issue a token and verify again.

reasonHints.contains: was re-issued while this check ran
reasonHints.hint: The token was replaced while the check ran. Publish the newest token and call verify again.
Redirects are never followed. Serve the file or header on the target host itself, make the base URL answer without a trailing-slash redirect, and exempt the path from any sign-in redirect.

reasonHints.contains: the host check did not finish
reasonHints.hint: The target host could not be looked up in time. Call verify again; if it persists, check the hostname's DNS.
The target host could not be looked up in time. Call verify again; if it persists, check the hostname's DNS.
The target answered too slowly. Make the file or base URL answer quickly without waking a cold-start backend, or use dns-txt, which does not depend on your server's response time.
The request did not complete. Check that the host answers HTTPS on port 443 with a valid, publicly trusted certificate and that a firewall does not block outside requests.
The file is not served at the target host's /.well-known/lightning-enable.json, or a CDN still serves a cached 404. Check the path on the target host itself and purge the cache.
Serve exactly {"verify":"<token>"}, with straight quotes and no comments.
The key must be verify, in lowercase.

reasonHints.contains: must be a string or an array of strings
reasonHints.hint: Put the token in quotes, or in an array of quoted tokens.
Serve only the verify field; the file must stay under 4 KB.

reasonHints.contains: "verify" does not contain this proxy's current token
reasonHints.hint: The file's token is old, mistyped, or cached. Publish the token you most recently issued, or issue a new one.
A TXT record exists, but none of its values is exactly the current token. Remove quotes, prefixes and old tokens, or issue a new token.
No TXT record is visible yet. A new record can take minutes to propagate; check with dig +short TXT on the record name. Many DNS providers append your zone, so enter only the part before it.

reasonHints.contains: does not carry this proxy's current token
reasonHints.hint: The header is there, but its value is not the current token. Publish the token you most recently issued.
The base URL answered without the header. Add it to every response at the base URL, including error responses and HEAD.

reasonHintFallback: Fix what the reason names for the method you published, then call verify again. Only that method needs to pass; the others failing is expected.

tokenStore._comment: Where a verification token is kept after it is shown once (by sell_url or verification_token): an owner-only JSON file beside config.json. verify reads it before pointing at verification_token.

sellUrlVerification._comment: sell_url passes the claim response's verification block through: claim fields in, result fields out. The token appears once in the result and is stored with source sell_url.
